source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why can a small skill consist of SKILL.md alone?

options.text: Supporting folders would prevent the catalog from selecting it
options.feedback: Supporting files are compatible with progressive disclosure. They are opened when needed rather than preventing selection.

options.text: Its procedure may need no additional supporting files
options.feedback: A focused procedure can fit in the central file. References, assets, and scripts are added when they serve a useful purpose.

options.text: The central file is intended to hold metadata without a procedure
options.feedback: SKILL.md contains both identifying metadata and instructions. A one-file skill still needs its reusable procedure.

options.text: A short procedure gains executable behavior from its filename
options.feedback: Naming an instruction document does not turn it into a script. Some useful skills rely on instructions without bundled executable code.
